from __future__ import annotations

class RingQueue:
    data: list[object]
    head: int
    size: int

    def __init__(self, capacity: int) -> None:
        if type(capacity) is not int or capacity <= 0:
            raise ValueError("capacity must be a positive integer")
        self.data: list[object] = [None] * capacity
        self.head: int = 0
        self.size: int = 0

    def enqueue(self, value: object) -> None:
        if self.size == len(self.data):
            raise OverflowError("full queue")
        index = (self.head + self.size) % len(self.data)
        self.data[index] = value
        self.size += 1

from __future__ import annotations

class RingQueue:
    data: list[object]
    head: int
    size: int

    def __init__(self, capacity: int) -> None:
        if type(capacity) is not int or capacity <= 0:
            raise ValueError("capacity must be a positive integer")
        self.data: list[object] = [None] * capacity
        self.head: int = 0
        self.size: int = 0

    def enqueue(self, value: object) -> None:
        if self.size == len(self.data):
            raise OverflowError("full queue")
        index = (self.head + self.size) % len(self.data)
        self.data[index] = value
        self.size += 1

    def dequeue(self) -> object:
        if self.size == 0:
            raise IndexError("empty queue")
        value = self.data[self.head]
        self.data[self.head] = None
        self.head = (self.head + 1) % len(self.data)
        self.size -= 1
        return value


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        q = RingQueue(2)
        q.enqueue("first")
        q.enqueue("second")
        print(q.dequeue())
        q.enqueue("third")
        print(q.dequeue(), q.dequeue())
    except (NotImplementedError, AttributeError, TypeError, IndexError, OverflowError) as error:
        print(error)

a, b = Node("paint"), Node("dry")
a.next = b
q = LinkedQueue()
q.head, q.tail, q.size = a, b, 2
assert (q.head.value, q.tail.value, q.size) == ("paint", "dry", 2)

q = LinkedQueue()
q.enqueue("wash")
first = q.head
q.enqueue("rinse")
assert q.head is first and first.next is q.tail
assert (q.head.value, q.tail.value) == ("wash", "rinse")

q = LinkedQueue()
for value in ["cut", "fold", "pack"]: q.enqueue(value)
assert q.dequeue() == "cut"
assert q.head.value == "fold" and q.tail.value == "pack"

q = LinkedQueue()
q.enqueue("inspect"); q.enqueue("label")
assert q.peek() == q.peek() == q.dequeue() == "inspect"
assert process_deque([("right", "reed"), ("right", "pine"), ("left", "oak"), ("take_right", None), ("take_left", None)]) == (["pine", "oak"], ["reed"])

q = RingQueue(5)
q.head, q.size = 4, 3
assert [(q.head + j) % len(q.data) for j in range(q.size)] == [4, 0, 1]
assert (q.head + q.size) % len(q.data) == 2

q = RingQueue(6)
q.head, q.size = 5, 2
q.data[5], q.data[0] = "old-1", "old-2"
q.enqueue("new")
assert q.data[1] == "new" and q.size == 3

q = RingQueue(3)
for value in ["east", "west", "up"]: q.enqueue(value)
assert q.dequeue() == "east"
q.enqueue("down")
assert q.data[0] == "down"
assert [q.dequeue(), q.dequeue(), q.dequeue()] == ["west", "up", "down"]
assert round_robin([("glaze", 2), ("fire", 1)]) == ["glaze", "fire", "glaze"]
assert window_maxima([4, 1, 6, 2], 3) == [6, 6]
assert ord("Z") == 90 and bucket_index("Z", 7) == 6
assert collision_buckets(["sun", "rain", "sun"], 1) == [["sun", "rain", "sun"]]

table = HashTable(1)
table.buckets[0] = [("brush", 4), ("tray", 2)]
table.size = 2
assert table.buckets[0][0][0] != table.buckets[0][1][0] and table.size == 2

table = HashTable(1)
table.put("glue", 3); table.put("glue", 7)
assert table.buckets == [[("glue", 7)]] and table.size == 1

table = HashTable(1)
table.put("cloth", 5); table.put("wire", 8)
assert table.get("wire") == 8

table = HashTable(1)
for key in ["clay", "sand", "lime"]: table.put(key, 1)
assert table.delete("sand")
assert [key for key, _ in table.buckets[0]] == ["clay", "lime"]

table = HashTable(2)
table.buckets = [[("ink", 2)], [("paper", 5), ("tape", 1)]]
table.size = 3
assert table.entries() == [("ink", 2), ("paper", 5), ("tape", 1)]

table = HashTable(10)
for key in ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e"]: table.put(key, 1)
assert table.load_factor() == 0.5
assert 3 / 4 == 0.75 and 6 / 3 == 2

table = HashTable(7)
table.put("Z", 12)
assert table.buckets[6] == [("Z", 12)]
table.rehash(8)
assert table.buckets[2] == [("Z", 12)] and table.get("Z") == 12

table = ProbingTable(4)
for key in ["c", "g", "k"]: table.put(key, key)
assert [table.slots[i][0] for i in [3, 0, 1]] == ["c", "g", "k"]
assert table.get("k") == "k"

table = ProbingTable(4)
table.put("b", 1); table.put("f", 2)
assert table.delete("b") and table.get("f") == 2
assert table.slots[2] is not None

table = frequency_index(["felt", "cord", "felt"])
assert table.get("felt") == 2 and table.get("cord") == 1

assert linear_search(["pin", "hook", "clip", "hook"], "hook") == 1
assert linear_search(["pin", "hook", "clip", "hook"], "cord") == -1
assert search_with_key([("reed", 5), ("stone", 8)], 8, lambda row: row[1]) == 1

assert binary_search([2, 6, 11, 15, 20], 11) == 2
assert binary_search([2, 6, 11, 15, 20], 14) == -1

assert binary_search_range([3, 7, 7, 12, 18], 7, 2, 4) == 2
assert binary_search_range([3, 7, 7, 12, 18], 18, 2, 4) == -1

values = [1, 5, 5, 5, 9]
assert [lower_bound(values, target) for target in [5, 7, 10]] == [1, 4, 5]

values = [2, 6, 6, 6, 10]
assert (lower_bound(values, 6), upper_bound(values, 6)) == (1, 4)
assert lower_bound(values, 8) == upper_bound(values, 8) == 4

values = [1, 6, 6, 9]
assert insert_sorted(values, 6) == 3 and values == [1, 6, 6, 6, 9]
assert measured_binary_search([2, 7, 12, 16, 21], 12) == (2, 1)
